model.title: Medication Affordability and Patent Integrity Act
model.meta: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee · Sen. Maggie Hassan (D-NH)

summary.text: The bill would require pharmaceutical companies to submit certain information and communications to federal health and patent agencies when seeking approval for new drugs or maintaining approval for existing medications. This aims to increase transparency and potentially help the government better understand patent-related issues that may affect drug affordability.
